name: Ralf the Record Rat
overview: Ralf the Record Rat, a series of 1 minute shorts, based on the syndicated strip format. The stories consist of our hero Ralf attempting to break world records - any world record - and, in the true spirit of "close but no cigar", failing. Ralf is the ultimate positive, kind, jolly and goodnatured character, so his lack of success never brings him down. His motto being "better luck next time", he merrily moves along to his next attempt at breaking a world record - any world record - and ... fails. But, somehow, he always comes out on top!
